text: At TB Tools revision c4b5b8fb8c80bafd44a62cffbb119234008f5efa, publishProjectLessons publishes private lessons only for repositories listed in shareRepositories. It creates shared summary evidence and a provisional shared lesson, retaining original lesson and private evidence IDs for audit. It does not publish the raw private evidence or its original quotes. The summary is a recorded interpretation, not independent verification. Missing evidence or evidence from another repository stops publication. This describes the unmerged implementation branch, not established default-branch behavior.
title: Private lesson publication remains provisional
